entities.summary: Rubber Boom and Colonial Society, a transformative movement in Malaysia (1895–1942). Emerged from Pangkor Treaty — British impose the Residential System on Perak and Pangkor Treaty. Catalyzed Japanese forces conquer Malaya and capture Singapore.
